title: Archive Operations Foundation, Lightweight Storage Status, Durable Coordination, Replay Truth and Storage Root Visual Polish
summary: Establishes the accepted Stage 13.5 archive-operations foundation without exposing unfinished workflows. Storage status is now lightweight and read-only, destructive work uses durable coordination, scope conflicts, leases, bounded public operation truth and restart-safe replay, and camera deletion preserves exact terminal outcomes. Storage-root controls receive the accepted compact visual polish while retention, integrity, migration and final UX work remain staged separately.
changelog: Adds a durable storage-operation model with bounded progress, result history, terminal cleanup and restart-safe ownership.
Moves recurring storage status to bounded SQL aggregates, root and capacity probes and durable summaries without reconciliation or migration planning.
Adds DB-backed worker leadership and coalesced high-watermark signals for automatic storage work.
Defines common volume, root, camera and segment conflict scopes with a fixed destructive lock order tied to active recorder write guards.
Preserves permission, actor, idempotency, lease, fencing, retry and next-action truth across terminal operation replay.
Adapts root activation and deletion, migration, retention, reconciliation and recording deletion to the shared operation foundation.
Fixes camera-delete replay so failed, blocked and cancelled outcomes never imply camera removal or partial cleanup.
Terminalizes successful camera deletion as completed and partial archive cleanup as partial without repeating mutation or audit on replay.
Uses database time for lease-effective status and keeps recurring status paths read-only and bounded.
Keeps unfinished Stage 4.10.2 through 4.10.5 workflows out of the primary UI while exposing only truthful compatibility status.
Aligns archive-root state controls, delete icon geometry, spacing and metric rows with the accepted KM VMS visual language.
